newsitem.title: USA: Malan praises World Bank anti-corruption stance.
newsitem.headline: Malan praises World Bank anti-corruption stance.

text.p: Brazilian Finance Minister Pedro Malan said on Thursday his country is in full agreement with World Bank efforts to fight corruption.

"My understanding is that the Bank would like to make absolutely sure that (in) ... bidding procedures and procurement there will be no scope for corruption," said Malan, speaking to reporters at the Brazilian Embassy here. "We entirely agree and share in that."
Malan said that while multilateral organizations face constraints in fighting corruption due to sovereignty considerations, there is a need to speak out against bribery and other such practices.
"I think it's good to have people speaking forcefully against corruption," he said.
